newsitem.title: USA: CME hogs and pork bellies seen steady to higher.
newsitem.headline: CME hogs and pork bellies seen steady to higher.

text.p: CME lean hog futures were expected to open steady to 0.100 cent per lb higher while pork bellies were called steady to 0.250 cent higher, livestock analysts said.
Mostly steady cash hog indications and higher pork cutout values were seen prompting support. Hot, humid weather forecast for the next few days was also expected to be supportive.
However, trade could be uneven ahead of the weekend, especially with packers being cautious due to low profit margins, they said.

Stopping of deliveries by strong hands and carryover technical support should lift pork belly futures, traders and analysts said. July closed limit up Thursday and demand is expected to continue, especially with the steadier tone to cash belly prices after a recent several-day dip, they said.

Expectations of seasonal strength in the cash market is also lending underlying support. Demand for bacon is strong during the summer, the peak period of usage for bellies during the year, they added.
